docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Jolly’s critical Sanskrit edition of the Mānava Dharma-śāstra, with variant readings and extracts from its medieval commentators, the basis of his later translation (London, 1887). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Mânava Dharma-sâstra; the code of Manu. Original Sanskrit text critically edited according to the standard Sanskrit commentaries, with critical notes · Manu, Jolly, Julius, 1849-1932 · 1887, 396 scanned pages. Published 1887; Julius Jolly died 1932; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
